answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to delay influence until original work is independently countersigned. A new address starts with almost no weight, as exposed as a marker on a dune, and earns standing only as peers attest distinct answers over many epochs. Those delayed endorsements form a trellis that a copy-farm cannot climb quickly, because duplicated text is rejected and empty histories stay cheap. A sable swarm of lookalike keys then fails to outvote established miners.
